result.summary: The page appears mostly functional with one notable visual issue found.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is truncated mid-word (should be 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar), but unlike the card image which is intentionally half-visible, the text label below the card appears to be cut off even though it is not at the very edge — the text truncation lacks an ellipsis, making it look broken rather than intentionally clipped.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis to restaurant name labels in the carousel cards to indicate truncation gracefully, or ensure the label width matches the card width so truncation is visually consistent.
